newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony Corp shares jump in morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Sony Corp shares jump in morning trade.

text.p: Sony Corp jumped in early morning Tuesday trade as investors continued to buy the global, blue-chip issue, encouraged by the possibility of the company entering the satellite business, brokers said.
As of 0052 GMT, the shares were up 120 yen at 7,950, ranking 13th on the list of most heavily traded issues on the first section of the Tokyo bourse. Turnover stood at 1.08 million shares.

Late last week, Sony said it was mulling participation in Japan Sky Broadcasting Co, or JSkyB, a satellite broadcasting venture. Softbank Corp is already a partner in the venture along with News Corp of Australia.
